text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Pardon me, Ruler.
I would ask for your counsel.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
This 'Account Settings' configuration...
From where might one access it?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Ah,
it's the third one down in the settings menu. Also,
you'd better keep that second option turned off.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see... Understood.
I am rather unaccustomed to this thing called 'social media'.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I received instruction from Curren as well, but it seems mastering it will require some time.
I may have to rely on you again.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
............Heh.
Are you truly fine with that?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No. I merely thought that for a king,
you gave away your weakness rather easily.
—The board is quite easy to read right now, you know?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, very well. As long as it is against you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Should you devise a strategy and bare your fangs,
I have only to answer—and strike you down in turn.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—By the way, what might this display be?
Things resembling messages have been incessantly popping up for some time now...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
!? Your DMs are open!?
Wait, is that seriously the default setting—
Ugh, damn it... What a pain, give me that!!
